(357)༄༅/ /'gro mgon shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ // /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (357)༄༅// 'gro mgon shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/// /

(358)༄༅// na mo gu ru dzña na ḍā ki nī yai/ /rdo rje 'chang las de nyid brnyes// mi slob zung 'jug grub pa mo// ye shes ḍā ki gnyis dang*// dbyer med bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun// bla ma kho nar rags lus phyir// de nyid mnyes byed skal ldan la// 'dod pa'i don rnams lhug par 'jo// de bas bya ba gzhan spangs la// bla ma mchod pa yang dag brtsam// mdo rgyud bstan bcos thams cad dang*// dri med gdams pa'i nying khu yin// sgrub pa po mos gus dang ldan zhing dkon mchog kun 'dus kyi ngo bo bla ma la yid ches pa'i skal pa can dag gis nyams len snying por bya ba ni 'di yin te/ de'ang 'byor ba yod na/ gnas gtsang mar rgyan dang yo byad kyi bkod pas spras pa'i gung du tshogs kyi rten bris sku la sogs pa bzhugs su gsol ba'i spyan sngar/ maṇ+ḍal/ chu gnyis nyer spyod gtso bor gyur pa'i mchod rdzas ci tsam 'byor ba dag gtsang zhing dag la ser snas ma gos pa dang*/ khyad par can gyi dus mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor chos sku mkha' khyab chen por mngon par byang chub pa'i dus mchod dgun ra ba'i bcu bzhi lta bur tshogs kyi yo byad kyang rgyas par bsham/ 'byor pas dben pa'am/ spros med kyi rnal (359) 'byor lta bur maṇ+ḍal nyer spyod tsam gang 'dzom gyis kyang chog /gtso bor 'khor ba las blo nges par 'byung zhing mchog gi dngos grub don du gnyer ba'i dad pa dang*/ bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar la yid ches kyi mos gus dung nge ba'i sgo nas/ thog mar skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad skyabs kun 'dus kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che la skyabs su mchi ba lags so/ /lan kha yar brjod/ sems bskyed pa ni/ sems can thams cad kyi don du zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du zab lam bla ma mchod pa nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/

/lan gsum/ bgegs bsal ba ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis dpal 'khor lo sdom pa yum dang bcas pa'i skur gyur/ lha dang lha min gsang ba pa// lus srul la sogs gang ci'ang rung*// lus ngag sems la gnas pa yi// bgegs kyi tshogs rnams nga la nyon// nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje'i stobs// srung ba'i 'khor lo rab sbyor bas// rdo rje 'bar ba'i sku yis (360)ni// lus gsum las skyes dgas par bya// gal te kha cig bdag las 'da'// rnam par brlag 'gyur gzhan du min// sum+bha ni brjod la tshan rngam bya/ sna tshogs 'od kyi 'phro 'du las// phyogs kun rdo rje 'bar ba'i gur// phyi rol ye shes me dpung 'bar// rab brtan srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur// oṃ badz+ra tsakra ra bh+rūm̐ hūm̐/ mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ bsangs chu la dmigs te/ /oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ nyer gcig tsam gyis byin brlabs la 'thor te sngags de nyid kyis bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bh+rūm̐ las rin po che las grub pa'i gzhal med khang brtsegs mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod rdzas bzang zhing dge ba nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pad+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhūpe/ ā lo ke /ghan+dhe/ nai bid+ya/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ zhes rol mos byin dbab/ tshogs rten sgrub pa ni/ dag pa'i zhing khams rgya che bkod legs shing*// do mtshar rgyan bkod bsam mi khyab pa'i mkhar// rdo rje nor bu'i khang brtsegs dpe med pa// thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas yangs pa'i dbus// seng khri pad dkar zla ba rgyas pa'i steng*// rtsa ba'i bla ma ye shes ḍā ki nī// su kha sid+dhi dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs// dbu skra sil bu spyan gsum hrig ger gzigs// phyag g.yas (361)bdud rtsis bkang ba'i thod pa bsnams// g.yon pas skye med mtshon pa'i phyag rgya mdzad// rus pa'i rgyan ldan zhabs gnyis gar stabs tshul// ye shes sku can 'ja' 'od klong na bzhugs// de yi spyi bor drug pa rdo rje 'chang*// rdo rje bdag med yum dang mnyam par sbyor// gtso bo'i mtha' skor mdun sogs phyogs bzhi ru// rje btsun mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug ni gu ma// smug nag spyan gsum lta stangs mkha' la gzigs// cang te'u thod pa rdo rje'i kha ṭ+wāṃ 'chang*// rus pa'i rgyan ldan zhabs gnyis phyed skyil bzhugs// rgyal sras mai tri rnal 'byor spyod pa'i chas// rat+na de bī gaṅgā dha ris brten// sgra gcan 'dzin sbas 'chi med grub pa'i tshul// bsod nams 'byung gnas dge slong paṇa chen gzugs// bar mtshams paṇa chen rnal 'byor mkha' 'gro ma'i// chas ldan mkhas grub brgya dang lnga bcu bzhugs// de mdun sgrub brgyud mnga' bdag khyung po rje// chos gos rnam gsum paṇa zhwa dmar po gsol// phyag g.yas sa gnon g.yon pa ngal gso'i stabs// phyed skyil rol pas pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs// bka' bab thugs sras chen po rnam drug nas// rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du rim byon pa'i// bka' brgyud nor bu'i phreng ba 'dzin pa rnams// phal cher gtsang sgom ngur smrig 'chang ba la// la la rnal 'byor spyod sogs ma nges tshul/

gang la gang 'dul mos pa'i dpal du 'char// kun kyang skye med rtogs pa'i gding dang ldan// sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba bsam mi khyab// ting 'dzin sgo brgyar rtag tu snyoms par 'jug /brtul zhugs (362)cho 'phrul phyogs med kun tu grub// mdzad pa phrin las phyogs bcu dus gsum khyab// byin rlabs thugs rje'i gzi byin tshad med 'bar// steng phyogs bla ma mtha' skor yi dam lha// sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma// chos skyong dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas// dpal ldan bla ma'i gsang gsum rol par shar// gang zhig bla ma sangs rgyas yid byed pa// de yi mdun na mngon sum bzhugs par gyur/ /'dir spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol bya mi dgos kyang las dang po pa'i blo dman rnams la 'char bde ba ltar na/ skyes mchog gnyis med ye shes spyan can rnams// chos kyi sku la gshegs 'byon mi mnga' yang*// gzugs sku brtse ba chen po'i rnam 'phrul gyis// dad ldan mchod pa'i zhing du gshegs su gsol// rat+na gu ru sa pa ri bā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ /mgon po 'gro ba'i don la byon pa legs// bdag gi mchod yon 'di nyid bzhes nas kyang*// ji srid mchod pa'i bya ba ma rdzogs bar// yid 'ong gdan la bde bar bzhugs su gsol/ oṃ pra lba ra sat+ka ra ar+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tshā swā hā/ de bzhin/ pād+yaṃ sbyar la chu gnyis phul/ oṃ pad+ma ā sa ni sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes sngar bskyed pa dang gnyis su med par gdan la bzhugs par mos/ dngos su phyag bya ba'am thal mo sbyar te/ /rnam dag sku ni skyon bral 'khrul pa med// phun tshogs gsungs dbyangs shes bya ma lus khyab// zab dang rgya che'i de nyid mkhyen pa'i thugs// rdo rje gsum dngos dpal ldan bla mar 'dud// sgrib gnyis bag chags bcas pa gtan nas sbangs// dag pa gnyis ldan yon tan thams cad rdzogs// rang gzhan don gyur sku gnyis mngon mdzad pa// 'khor 'das ma lus sprul par mdzad la 'dud// g.yo med sems kyis bsten na skad cig la// byin gyis brlabs pas bla med byang chub lam// yang na 'dod pa mchog dang thar pa yi/

(363)dam pa nges par sbyin mdzad khyod la 'dud// lhan skyes zung 'jug srid gsum bde chen dngos// dmigs med thugs rjes khams gsum 'gro kun sgrol/ mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yon tan zad mi mnga'// chos dbyings rnam dag g.yo med khyod la 'dud// nyid kyi ye shes gcig gi rang snang las// ma lus rgyal ba sras bcas sprin spro ba// bden pa gnyis kyi rnam thar tshad mi mnga'// sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor 'dud// khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po rdo rje 'chang*// bdag med ma dang rje btsun bir wa pa// rgyal ba kun bskyed bde ba'i dngos grub dang*// sa bcu'i dbang phyug ni gu ma la 'dud// mai tri pa dang bsod nams 'byung gnas sbas// rā hu la sogs mkhas grub brgya lnga bcu// khyung po rnal 'byor rin chen brtson 'grus dang*// dpon ston gnyan ston chos rje ston par 'dud// mkhas grub rnam gsum khyung po tshul khrims mgon// ras chen shangs dkar sangs rgyas dpal bzang po// nam rgyal legs rgyal grol mchog lha dbang grags// rje btsun chen po tā ra nā thar 'dud// rgyal mtshan dpal bzang rdo rje gzhon nu che// nam mkha'i rnal 'byor byang sems sbyin pa bzang*// grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong rgyal po sogs// ring brgyud nye brgyud bla ma rnams la 'dud/ /phyi mchod 'bul ba ni/ mdog bzang dbyibs legs tshims pa'i dri bsung can// man+dā ra dang ut+pal ku mud sogs// dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa'i me tog kun// skyabs mchog dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs la 'bul// oṃ (364)rat+na gu ru sa pa ri bā ra badz+ra puṣ+pe pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐// rgyu bzang mnams na zhim pa'i dri ngad can// a ga ru dang tsan+dan sprul snying sogs// dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa'i bdug spos kun// skyabs mchog dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs la 'bul/

oṃ rat+na gu ru sa pa ri bā ra badz+ra dhū pe pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐// mun sel dngos kun gsal ba'i gzi brjid can// sgron me nyi zla lus kyi 'od la sogs// dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa'i snang gsal kun// skyabs mchog dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs la 'bul// oṃ rat+na gu ru sa pa ri bā ra badz+ra ā lo ke pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐// dri zhim byug na bde ba'i reg mchog kun// ga bur gla rtsi mnom pa'i dri la sogs// dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa'i dri mchog kun// skyabs mchog dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs la 'bul// oṃ rat+na gu ru sa pa ri bā ra badz+ra gan+dhe pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐// mdog bzang myangs na bde ba'i ro bcud can// 'bras chan ka ra rgya gtar khu ba sogs// dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa'i zhal zas kun// skyabs mchog dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs la 'bul// oṃ rat+na gu ru sa pa ri bā ra nai bid+ya pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐// don zab thos na snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs can// rnga chen dung dang pheg rdob rgyud mangs sogs// dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa'i sil snyan kun// skyabs mchog dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs la 'bul// oṃ rat+na gu ru sa pa ri bā ra shab+da pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐// srab 'jam yangs pa lha yi gos// mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku la gsol// mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na// bdag kyang rdo (365)rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ rat+na gu ru sa pa ri bā ra badz+ra was+t+ra ya āḥhūm̐ swā hā// mgon khyed bkres skyems mi mnga' yang*// 'o thug bur khu bdud rtsi'i chu// bza' dang bca' ba rgya chen po// kha dog dri ngad ro ldan pa// thams cad sbyar ba bshos kyi mchog /kun bzang bde chen bzhes su gsol// bde ba'i dngos grub dkyil 'khor gtso// bla ma mchog dang tha mi dad// bka' brgyud thams cad khyed kyi 'phrul/

de phyir snying nas gus phyag 'tshal// bdag ni skyabs gnas gzhan kun pas// ba spu'i khung bu gcig la yang*// lhag par yang ni dad lags pa// rmongs pas ma yin rgyu dang bcas// sangs rgyas kun las ches lhag par// rgyud sde kun tu rgyal bas bsngags// mdo sogs kun tu mtshungs par gsungs// rgyal bas nan tan bstod la 'dud// phyogs bcu'i 'dren pa rgyal sras kyis// byang sems rdo rje bzhin du blta/ thams cad nyin re dus bzhi ru// phyag 'tshal mchod nas 'di skad du// bdag cag de bzhin gshegs kun gyi// pha ma ston pa khyed ces sgrog /ston pa rdo rje 'dzin khyod la// skyob par bcas pas phyag 'tshal lo/ grangs med bskal par rgyal rnams la// rin chen zhing mchog phul ba bas// khyed kyi sku la til mar gyi// thig pas mchod na'ang bsod nams mchog /ci phyir zhe na sangs rgyas kyi// ye shes ma lus khyod las byung*// mchod pa thams cad spangs nas ni// rje btsun khyod la mchod cing 'dud// rdo rje gsum gyi dngos grub chogs// nyid kyi sku gsung thugs la gnas// khyod ni gang la'ang mi gnas te// mkha' (366)mnyam 'od gsal rmad byung che// rtsod pa'i dus 'dir rdo rje sems// dngos su mthong ba'i skal med pas// slob dpon gzugs kyis sgrub rnams la// brtse bas mchod pa len la 'dud// rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor ye shes lnga// 'gro ba 'dul phyir phung po lnga// tshad med lha mo bzhi'i dkyil 'khor// 'byung bzhir ston pa ya mtshan rmad// spyan sogs yang ni sems dpa' brgyad// tshigs sogs yang dag khro bo bcu// gzugs sogs yang ni rdo rje ma// ye shes sku la bdag phyag 'tshal// skye 'chi can gyi sku'o zhes// log par bzung ba gnong zhing 'gyod// de bas bsam pa thag pas bshags// bdag kyang khyod ltar mngon gyur cig /byang chub phyogs chos sum cu bdun// bcom ldan sku yi cha shas lags// cod pan rigs lnga ba spu rnams// dgra bcom lags te de bas 'dud// 'jig rten lha rnams khyed kyi gdan// srid gsum bla ma khyed nyid lags// khyed ni dkon mchog gsum lags shing*// rin chen gsum gyi byed por gsungs// g.yo sgyu tshig tsam ma yin par// deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar// bsam pa thag pas skyabs su mchi// lhag par dad pas phyag 'tshal lo/

/bar 'dir maṇ+ḍal tshom bu so bdun ma spyi mthun rgyas pa dang*/ bkod pa shin tu mdzes pa'i maṇ+ḍal mchog /dbus kyi ri rgyal gling bzhi gling phran bcas// gsal byed nyi ma zla bas bskor zhing mdzes// phyi rol lcags ri bar ni rol mtshos brgyan// rin chen dpag bsam shing dang 'dod 'jo'i ba// rgyal srid sna bdun rin chen gter dang brgyad// ma rmos lo tog yan lag brgyad ldan chu// phyi nang gsang gsum mchod sprin bsam mi (367)khyab// dga' dang spro ba skyed pa'i maṇ+ḍal 'di// don gnyis bsgrub par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas// brtson pa'i stobs kyis bla ma yi dam dang*// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la dbul bar bya// sangs rgyas kun gyi gdung 'dzin rnal 'byor pas// mnyes byed maṇ+ḍal bzang po 'di phul bas// nyes skyon dri ma'i tshogs rnams kun spangs nas// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /zhes maṇ+ḍal bka' rgya ma'ang 'bul/ 'khor lo nor bu btsun mo dam pa dang*// blon po glang po rta mchog dmag dpon te// rgyal srid rin chen sna bdun dpag med kyang*// mngon par sprul nas bla ma mchog la 'bul// ral gri pags pa skyed tshal khang khyim dang*// gzims cha gos dang mchil l+h+wam rin po che// bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// rgyal ba rnams kyi 'dod 'byung lha mo'i tshul// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya'i bde ster ma// me long pi wang sbos khang bza' btung snod// ras phran bzang dang pad+ma bhañdza na// cang te'u sgra sgrog kha ṭ+wāṃ la brten ma// dkar sngo ser dang dmar dang ljang ba'i gzugs// gzugs mdzes dbyangs snyan dri ldan bcud ldan ma// bde ldan lang tshos dregs pa'i smin legs ma// nam mkha' gang bas bla ma lha tshogs mchod// bde mchog sgyu ma'i longs spyod rdzogs gsal ma// pi wang gling bu rnga zlum rdza rnga can// rgod dang sgeg dang glu len bro gar mkhan// me tog bdug pa snang gsal dri mchog ma// gzugs ma ro ma reg ma chos 'byung ma// bcu drug dga' ba'i cha shas yongs rdzogs ma// rdo rje rig ma dga' bas (368)rol pa 'dis// he ru ka khyod rdo rje yid dgyes mdzod// khrus kyi rdzing bu dam pa dang*// reg na bde ba lha yi gos// mkha' lding khyu mchog rma bya dang*// glang po rta sogs theg pa'i mchog

/dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i 'dod 'jo'i ba// ma rmos 'khrungs pa'i lo tog dang*// dpag bsam shing dang 'bras bu'i mchog /bum bzang nam mkha' gang bas mchod// bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang*// dus gsum dge ba kun yang 'bul/ gser dngul mu tig bai ḍūr+ya// rin chen zhing rnams bkang nas 'bul// dbang sngon rdo rje pad+ma dmar// ma rgad bye ru dzam+bu'i gser// zla shel rin chen bdun gyi ri// zhing gi rdul snyed dbul bar bgyi// ut+pal pad+ma kha dog lnga// dzā ti kha dog rnam pa gsum// me tog karni ka ra dang*// mā li ka dang yu thi ka /me tog ka ra lbī ra yang*// bsam gtan stobs kyis khyod la 'bul// mi 'jigs seng ge rin chen khri/ pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan mchog dang*/ rna rgyan dang ni gdub bu dang*// mgul rgyan sor gdub dam pa dang*// gser las byas pa'i mchod phyir thogs// dbu rgyan dar dpyangs do shal bcas// rgyal mtshan dmar dang de bzhin ser// dkar dang gnag dang ser skya dang*/ de bzhin gos ni sna tshogs dang*// me tog phreng ba du ma dang*// bla bre dag las dar dpyangs pa'i// mda' dang yol bas shin tu mdzes// de bzhin bza' bca' btung ba yis// rab mnyam bzhag pas mchod par bya// gser ni brgya stong du ma dang*// rin chen rnam pa sna tshogs dang*// ras ni zung gyur brgya nyid dang*// glang po rta dang yul 'khor dang*// chung ma bzang dang bu mo nyid// bran pho bran mo sring mo dang*// blo ldan kun nas dang ba yis// bdag nyid (369)kyang ni dbul bar bgyi// bdud rtsi lnga yi bza' ba ni// dngos grub kun gyi de nyid mchog /sgron ma lnga yi bza' ba ni// sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig gtso// nyes bral zhi ba'i btung ba mchog /sbrang rtsi bu ram 'bru dang shing*// bcos pa'i myos byed rnam pa lnga// shes rab rang bzhin dbul bar bgyi// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ thabs shes lhan cig sbyor ba las// rang bzhin snang ba yongs dag pa'i// zhu bdes khams gsum kun khyab pa// gsang ba'i mchod pas mnyes par bgyi// khong stong khyod kyi sku la med// sha dang rus pa khrag kyang med// nam mkha' la ni 'ja' tshon ltar// khyed kyi sku ni ston mdzad 'dud// sku la bsnyun med mi gtsang med// bkres dang skom pa 'byung med kyang*// khyed ni 'jig rten rjes 'jug phyir// 'jig rten bya ba ston mdzad 'dud// chu zla bzhin du gzung du med// chos rnams gang la'ang gnas pa med// nga rgyal med cing mi gnas pa// dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// gshegs dang bzhugs dang de bzhin gzims// spyod lam dag ni thams cad du// rtag par mnyam par 'jog gyur pa'i// dmigs med khyed la phyag 'tshal bstod// sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis// rdzu 'phrul che la rnam 'phrul cing*// sna tshogs min la snyoms 'jug pa'i// dmigs med khyed la phyag 'tshal bstod/

khams gsum las ni rnam grol zhing*// nam mkha' dang ni mnyam gyur la// 'dod pa rnams kyis ma gos pa'i// dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// phung po rnams dang khams rnams dang*// skye mched rnams la mi brten cing*// phyin ci log las rnam grol ba'i// dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// rnam rtog (370)med cing kun rtog med// thugs ni rab tu mi gnas la// bsam gyis mi khyab pa yi thugs// dmigs med khyed la phyag 'tshal bstod// ji ltar nam mkha' gnas med cing*// spros med gos pa med pa ltar// mkha' dang mnyam pa'i thugs mnga' ba// dmigs med khyed la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'gro ba chu yi zla ba bzhin du lta ba dang*// thos pa brag cha dang ni mtshungs par dag 'jug /sems kyang mya ngan smig rgyu lta bur blta bya zhing*// 'di ltar bza' dang btung ba dag ni nam mkha' lta bu ste// dri ni nam mkha'i me tog mtshungs par gnas pa dang*// yid ni nyi ma zla ba lta bur khyab pa nyid// yang dag gnas pa de yang ri bo mchog dang mtshungs pa yin// gzhon nu ma yi rmi lam ji bzhin rmi bar bya// tha snyad dag ni sgyu ma mig 'phrul lta bur brjod// 'di ltar ji bzhin lhan skyes bde 'byung de bzhin te// srid pa'i rang bzhin bral ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa yi thugs// rtag tu 'char ba bde gshegs lam mchog dag gis mchod// zab zhi spros dang bral ba gnyug ma'i don// snang dang stong pa gnyis dang gnyis min la// e ma ho 'di snyam bral ba'i lta ba can// bde chen lhan skyes rol pa khyod la 'dud// smra bsam brjod du med pa'i rang bzhin la// bde stong 'dzin pa med pa bde ba'i nyams// e ma ho rtsol bral lhug pa'i sgom pa can// bde chen lhan skyes rol pa khyed la 'dud// spang blang byar med rang bzhin 'od gsal la// gzung 'dzin glo bur dri ma rnam dag pa// e ma ho rang bzhin lhun grub 'bras bu can// bde chen lhan skyes rol pa khyed la 'dud/

/zhes phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod bstod bya// de nas brgyud pa'i bla ma'i gsol 'debs rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa dang*// khyad par (371) gnas sbyar ma lugs gnyis sogs skabs 'dir 'don// yongs khyab dang ldan zhing rgyas par spro na/ /gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa// kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan sku// bde stong zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang*// rigs kun khyab bdag zhabs la 'dud// dus gsum sangs rgyas skyed pa'i yum// brgyud 'dzin bu la dngos grub ster// zag med ye shes ḍā ki ni// su kha sid+dhi'i zhabs la 'dud// lhan skyes shes rab pha rol phyin// mi phyed gsang ba kun gyi mdzod// mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug ni gu ma// rdo rje btsun mo'i zhabs la 'dud// ri khrod mgon pos byin gyis brlabs// snying po don gyi gsang mdzod 'dzin// mtshan thos don ldan rgyal ba'i sras// mai tri pa yi zhabs la 'dud// grub mchog mnga' bdag chen po dang*// mkhyen rtogs dbyer med rnal 'byor ma// mkha' spyod gsang ba'i dbang mo mchog /rad+na de bī'i zhabs la 'dud// byang chub sems kyi rtsal chen rdzogs// rdo rje gdan du bstan pa skyong*// mthong thos dran reg bde la bkod// bsod nams 'byung gnas zhabs la 'dud// khyad par lha bzhis byin gyis brlabs// phyag rgya chen po'i go 'phang grub// rdo rje'i lus kyis rab bzhugs pa// rā hu la yi zhabs la 'dud// byang chub sems kyi mnga' bdag mchog /bod khams mun pa sel ba'i sgron// sa gsum grags pas khyab pa yi// a ti sha yi zhabs la 'dud// bcom ldan 'das mas rjes su bzung*// thub pa'i dbang po'i rgyal srid skyong*// sangs rgyas gnyis pa lta bur grags// 'jigs (372)med 'byung gnas zhabs la 'dud// nā ro paṇa chen thugs kyi sras// man ngag rgya mtsho'i pha mthar son// skye dgu'i mgon gyur dha chen po// byang chub sems dpa'i zhabs la 'dud// tha dad yul dang dud 'gro'i skad// ma bslab pa yi bstan bcos sogs// rtsa gnas dgongs pa gtad pas mkhyen// ta thā ga ta'i zhabs la 'dud// brtul zhugs spyod pa phyogs med grub// mthu stobs phrin las thogs pa med// mi 'jigs gding ldan grub pa'i rje// don yod rdo rje'i zhabs la 'dud// gsung rab kun la mkhyen pa rgyas// gzhan phan bsam mi khyab pa mdzad// ngo mtshar snyan pa dang ldan pa// blo gros bzang po'i zhabs la 'dud// mkhyen rtogs nus pa'i rtsal chen rdzogs// bar dor mchog gi dngos grub brnyes// bai ro tsa na rak+ṣi ta// rnal 'byor dbang po'i zhabs la 'dud// gshin rje gshed dang dbyer med cing*// mu stegs kla klo'i rigs kyi gshed// bsam pa tsam gyis las rnams 'grub// pad+ma srung pa'i zhabs la 'dud// rnam 'joms dkyil 'khor dngos su sprul// rdo rje dril bu mkha' la 'jog

/dus gsum gzigs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta// gnyis med rdo rje'i zhabs la 'dud// bde chen bde ba'i gzi mdangs can// lta bas mi ngoms sgeg pa'i nyams// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi rje// kun tu bzang mo'i zhabs la 'dud// sa dang lam rnams mthar phyin te// rnal 'byor rtogs pa'i ye shes sbar// rdo rje'i gsang ba 'dzin pa mo// su ma ti yi zhabs la 'dud// ye shes mkha' la rnam par 'gro// skal pa ldan rnams rjes su 'dzin// sprul sgyur sna tshogs gzugs can ma// ka na ka shrī'i (373)zhabs la 'dud// sa 'og dpal gyi sgor bzhud nas// ral gri'i grub pas da lta yang*// lha min sems can don mdzad pa// gaṅgā dha ris zhabs la 'dud// rol rdor bde ba'i rdo rje dang*// dharma pha la 'phags pa lha// bhan+dha pa sogs mkhas grub ni// brgya dang lda bcu'i zhabs la 'dud// lhag pa'i bslab pa gsum gyis spras// snang ba mtha' yas thugs las sprul// 'brel tshad don ldan byang chub sems// glang thang pa yi zhabs la 'dud// shes bya kun mkhyen dbang bcu brnyes// ye shes ḍā ki'i gsang ba 'dzin// rgyud sde lnga yi ngo bo nyid// khyung po rnal 'byor zhabs la 'dud// ngo mtshar srid mtha'i byang chub sems// thogs med mkha' la bya ltar lding*// rlung sems dbang thob rmog lcogs pa// rin chen brtson 'grus zhabs la 'dud// ting 'dzin sgo brgyar dbang du mdzad// tshad med thugs rjes 'gro ba 'dren// spyan ras gzigs dbang skyer sgang pa// chos kyi seng ge'i zhabs la 'dud// sangs rgyas dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i sku// ye shes mgon po bran du khol// sa bcu'i dbang phyug ri gong pa// gnyan ston chen po'i zhabs la 'dud// bde stong 'gyur med sku lnga'i bdag /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i drwa ba sdom// rdo rje'i rgya bkrol 'gro ba'i mgon// sangs rgyas ston pa'i zhabs la 'dud// sangs rgyas zhing sbyong 'gro smin mdzad// bla na med pa'i cho 'phrul ston// mkhas grub gtsang ma shangs ston rje// tshul khrims 'bum pa'i zhabs la 'dud// gzungs dang ting 'dzin mngon shes sogs// bsam mi khyab pa'i rnam thar can// mkhas grub chen po bsam sdings pa// gzhon nu grub mchog zhabs la 'dud// mthong thos dran reg sgrol mdzad pa'i// rgyal sras dpa' (374)bo'i spyod pa 'chang*// mkhas btsun mchog gyur 'jag chen pa// rgyal mtshan 'bum gyi zhabs la 'dud// bsam bzhin srid par sku sprul nas// 'khor ba dong sprugs sems dpa' che// khyung po gnyis par grags pa yi// tshul khrims mgon po'i zhabs la 'dud// gzung 'dzin mdud pa dbyings su grol// 'byung ba bzhi po dbang du mdzad// brtul zhugs mthar phyin ras chen pa// sangs rgyas seng ge'i zhabs la 'dud// mkhyen pa gnyis kyi rtsal chen rdzogs// spyan lnga rnam par dag pa 'char// rgyal ba'i gdung 'dzin shangs dkar ba// rin chen rgyal mtshan zhabs la 'dud// bde stong gzi brjid 'od du 'bar// 'khor 'das sgyu ma'i lus su rtogs// dngos grub mchog brnyes lkugs lung pa// sangs rgyas dpal bzang zhabs la 'dud// ci snang ye shes 'khor lor dag

/las dang dngos grub thogs med grub// rmad byung mchog gi grub pa che// nam mkha'i rgyal mtshan zhabs la 'dud// 'khor 'das gnyis la sbang blang bral// chos kun mngon sangs rgyas par gzigs// sbas pa'i sangs rgyas rgya sgom pa// legs pa rgyal mtshan zhabs la 'dud// ye shes mkha' 'gros rjes su bzung*// mkhyen nus phrin las mkha' dang mnyam// 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo che// kun dga' grol mchog zhabs la 'dud// snyan brgyud gdams pa'i gter mdzad 'dzin// grub pa bye ba'i gtsug gi rgyan// rnal 'byor dbang phyug brag stod pa// lha dbang grags pa'i zhabs la 'dud// rtsod pa'i dus kyi rdo rje 'chang*// 'jigs med shes bya thams cad mkhyen// gsang ba'i bdag po he ru ka /tā ra nā tha'i zhabs la 'dud// ye shes gcig gi ngo bo nyid// rnam 1(375)'phrul du ma'i gar mdzad pa// ston 'khor dbyer med rgyal tshab mchog /ye shes rgya mtsho'i zhabs la 'dud// skyes thob sbyangs pa'i yon tan ldan// gzhan rgyud smin cing grol nus pa'i// byin rlabs dpal 'bar rdzong steng pa// yon tan mgon po'i zhabs la 'dud// dka' grub brtul zhugs mtha' ru phyin// 'ja' lus mkha' spyod grong du gshegs// ngo mtshar rmad byung spong ba pa// mgon po dpal 'byor zhabs la 'dud// rim pa gnyis la brtan pa thob// de nyid bcu po dbang du 'byor// mtshan nyid kun ldan slob dpon mchog /mgon po grags pa'i zhabs la 'dud// nyams dang rtogs pa'i rtsal chen rdzogs// sgom pa'i drod rtags tshad la pheb// yon tan bsam yas grub pa'i dbang*// mgon po rnam rgyal zhabs la 'dud// dag pa'i sa la legs bzhugs shing*// sna tshogs sprul pas 'gro don mdzad// 'gran zla bral ba'i rig pa 'dzin// tshe dbang nor bu'i zhabs la 'dud// gdod nas mngon par byang chub kyang*// 'gro 'dren thugs rje rgyun mi 'chad// gangs can mgon po 'brug pa rje// phrin las shing rta'i zhabs la 'dud// byams chen ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i tshul// snyigs dus 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan// sgrub brgyud mnga' bdag 'jig rten mig

/bstan pa'i nyin byed zhabs la 'dud// gong ma'i brgyud 'dzin rnam thar skyong*// rtogs pa'i bdag nyid rmog lcogs pa// kun dga' dge legs dpal 'bar dang*// lhun grub rgya mtsho'i zhabs la 'dud// chos brgyad rnam g.yeng rtswa ltar dor// bas mthar sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs// 'khrul pa zhig pa'i skyes bu che// bka' brgyud bstan (376)'dzin zhabs la 'dud// 'khrul snang dbu ma'i dbyings su thim// dag pa'i snang ba rgyun chad med// sprul sgyur nus pa'i rnal 'byor pa// karma lhag mthong zhabs la 'dud// 'byung bzhi'i gnod pas mi brdzi zhing*// yi dam lha zhal grangs med gzigs// snang sems rang dbang sgyur ba'i rje// karma gzhan phan zhabs la 'dud/ ༈ /rdo rje 'chang dang bdag med ma// bir wa su kha sid+dhi'i zhabs// ni gu ma dang rdor gdan pa// rā hu la yi zhabs la 'dud// mkhas grub chen po brgya lnga bcu// khyung po rnal 'byor rmog lcogs pa// dbon ston gnyan ston 'gro ba'i mgon// gtsang ma shangs ston zhabs la 'dud// 'jig rten gsum po snyan pas khyab// 'jig rten skyong bas zhabs la btud// 'jig rten mgon po gnyags ston che// rgyal mtshan dpal bzang zhabs la 'dud// 'phrul dang mngon par shes la sogs// lam gyi yon tan mthar phyin kyang*// sbas pa'i brtul zhugs lhur bzhes pa// rdo rje gzhon nu'i zhabs la 'dud// srid pa'i 'ching ba rab tu bcad// spang rtogs yon tan bsam mi khyab// dpe bral nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa// nam mkha' rgyal mtshan zhabs la 'dud// tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i pha mthar son// stong nyid snying rje rtsol med mnga'// 'gro ba'i 'dren pa byang chub sems// sbyin pa bzang po'i zhabs la 'dud// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi rje// grub thob rgya mtsho'i 'khor los sgyur// tshe dbang mnga' brnyes lcags zam pa// thang stong rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud// yid bzhin nor bu ji bzhin tu// don gnyis 'bad med lhun gyis grub// dpal ldan shangs pa'i bka' srol (377)'dzin// brgyud pa'i bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i bdag

/mkhas dang grub pa kun gyi gtsug /'phags pa'i sa la rab bzhugs pa// mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i zhabs la 'dud// shangs pa'i thugs sras chen po drug /mkhas grub rnam gsum la sogs pa'i// gdan sa slob brgyud las byon pa'i// skyes mchog kun gyi zhabs la 'dud// 'jigs bral chen po yab sras sogs// ni dhi gnyis kyis rjes bzung zhing*// zab mo'i gdams pa spel mdzad pa'i// grub mchog rnams kyi zhabs la 'dud// dgyes pa rdo rje gsang ba 'dus// sgyu 'phrul chen mo 'khor lo sdom// 'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i ngo bo nyid// dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// sangs rgyas rdo rje rin po che// pad+ma las kyis mkha' 'gro ma// myur mdzad ye shes mgon po dang*// dbyer med bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum// ma lus gcig tu 'dus pa'i dngos// gcig chog rgyal po skyabs kyi phul// dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid// snyigs dus slob dpon gzugs su 'phrul// bsam mi khyab pa'i mdzad pa can// dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// khams dbang mos pa'i bye brag ltar// gsang gsum rnam thar sna tshogs ston// thabs mkhas thugs rje che mnga' ba'i// dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// nyes pa'i skyon rnams rab tu zad// legs pa'i yon tan ma lus rdzogs// rgyal ba sras bcas skyed mdzad pa// dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// mtshan tsam thos pas ngan 'gro sgrol// gsol (378)ba btab pas byin rlabs stsol// gus pas brten na 'dod rgu 'byung*// dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// yid bzhin nor bu lta bu yi// rtsa brgyud bla ma rin po che// 'di nas byang chub snying po'i bar// skyabs kyi mchog tu bzung par bgyi// bdag sogs mkha' mnyam sems can gyis// rdul snyed lus dang bstod pa'i ngag /yid ni rtse gcig gus btud de// phyag 'os khyod la phyag bgyi'o// kun bzang rnam rol mchod pa'i sprin// sgo gsum dge rtsa dang bcas pa// nam mkha' lta bu'i blos bzung ste// mchod 'os rnams la rtag tu mchod// thog med sgrib pa chen po dang*// bcas pa'i kha na ma tho sogs// nangs pa snying nas 'gyod bshags na// 'gro ba'i mgon pos tshangs par stsol// skyes mchog rnams kyi rnam par thar// ngo mtshar bla na med pa dang*// srid zhi'i legs spyad ci mchis la// dga' zhing gus pas yi rang ngo*// rigs dang mthun pa'i chos sgo dang*// khyad par sras bcas rgyal ba kun// bgrod pa gcig pa'i 'khor lo yis// 'khor ba dong nas sprugs par gsol// chos sku rgyun gyis rtag pa'i phyir// gzugs sku 'char nub mi ston par// mngon sum dbang po'i spyod yul du// rdo rje lta bur bzhugs su gsol// bsod nams 'di dang 'gro kun gyi// dge rtsa thun mong nyid byas te// bla ma'i gsang gsum mdzad par bcas// tshe gcig kho nas 'grub phyir bsngo// chos kyi rgyal po sras bcas kyi// thugs rje'i phyag gis yongs bzung ste// lam gyi mngon rtogs mthar phyin nas// rang gzhan don gnyis lhun grub shog

/bla ma las gzhan rgyal med pas// nam yang mi mnyes ma gyur cing*// sgo gsum zhabs tog dgu phrug gis/ (379)mnyes pa kho na sgrub nus shog /rtag tu dgyes pas byin rlobs shing*// thugs yid dbyer med 'dres nas su// spang rtogs bum pa gang byo bzhin// bdag gi rgyud la 'pho bar shog /rnam thar ji bzhin rtogs pa dang*// gsung gi gsang ba ma lus pa// stsal nas legs par 'dzin nus shing*// dar rgyas byed pa'i skal ldan shog /rdo rje theg pa'i rigs su skye// bla mas rjes bzung dam tshig 'chang*// rdo rje dril bu mi 'bral bar// ye shes yangs pa'i gar byed shog /rdo rje'i gsang ba 'dzin pa dang*// blang dor bral ba'i don rtogs nas// brtul zhugs phyogs med grub pa yis// 'jig rten sgron me gcig gyur shog /gzhan yang dpal dang dbang phyug dang*// nad med pa dang rdo rje'i tshe// chos mthun 'byor pa rab rgyas shing*// bstan pa phyogs brgyar spel byed shog /tshe 'dir mchog dngos ma grub na// 'phos ma thag tu bde ba can// khyung po yab sras zhabs drung du// skad cig tsam gyis skye bar shog /bzang ngan bar ma'i 'brel thogs kun// sgrib pa gnyis po rab bsal nas// snang ba mtha' yas zhing khams der// sprul pa du mas 'dren nus shog /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i rnam par thar// ma lus bdag gis myur 'grub ste// srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro sgrol ba'i// ded dpon khyod dang mtshungs par shog /zab mo bla ma'i rim pa yis// tshe gcig sangs rgyas sar sbyor ba// rdo rje 'chang gis rab gsungs pa'i// bden pas smon lam kun 'grub shog

/gzhan yang rgyun bshags// yan lag bdun pa'i rigs ji ltar nus pa skabs 'dir brjod// tshogs 'khor bya bar spro na rje btsun grol mchog gis mdzad pa'i bde mchog lha lnga'i tshogs mchod gsung rgyun ma ltar bya ba las// byin rlabs 'bebs pa'i thog mar/ /oṃ chos dbyings khyab brdal chen (380)po'i zhing*// 'khor 'das kun gyi snying po nas// rigs rnams kun gyi khyab bdag la// dpal ldan bla ma zhes su grags// rgyal ba sras bcas 'khor gyis bskor// khyed kyi rjes su bdag slob kyis// byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol// zag med bde ba sbyin pa'i gnas// tsan+dan sman gyi nags tshal du// rgyal yum rdo rje bdag med la// su kha sid+dhi zhes su grags// gdan gsum tshang pa'i 'khor gyis bskor// khyed kyi rjes su bdag slob kyis// byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol/ /zhes sbyar// myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po la gtor chog bsdus pa ltar gtor ma 'bul zhing*/ 'grub na mkha' 'gro sde lnga la'ang tshogs gtor zur du 'bul lo// tshogs lhag ma bcas zin nas/ /dmangs rigs nyis stong bram ze gcig dang mnyam// de bzhin bram ze dge slong rdul med dang*// ye shes ldan rnams stong phrag gnyis gnyis su// bsgres pa'ang slob dpon gcig dang zhing mnyam par// gsungs phyir mgon po rdo rje slob dpon khyod// zhing gi rab mchog phul dung byung med pas// rgyal khyod mnyes par byas na kun mkhyen mchog /ye shes bla med thob par yang yang gsungs// slob dpon rdo rje sems dpa' mchod pa des// bsod nams kun byas dka' thub thams cad bsten// sdig 'joms sdug bsngal zhi mdzad sred pa yi// rgya mtsho'i 'jings las sgrol mdzad la phyag 'tshal// khyod la rjes mthun gus pas yon phul na// rims sogs gnod pa mi 'byung phyogs bcu yi// rgyal ba kun la phul bar 'gyur bas na// dngos grub mchog ni nges par thob par gsungs// bdag gis dus gsum dge ba lus longs spyod// yongs su gzung ba med pa'i mchod rdzas dang*// smon (381)lam sngags dang phyag rgya ting 'dzin gyis// rab bsgrub phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul// khyod la brnyas bar byed pa kun// rgyal po me dang dug dang rims// log 'dren rnams kyis bsad nas kyang*// rtag tu dmyal bar 'tshed par gsungs// khyed la brnyas shing rmad na ni// sangs rgyas kun la brnyas shing smad// gzims cha stan dang l+h+wam dang gdugs// 'gom zhing co 'dri byed pa ni// don reng dpal nyams nad kyis thebs// sku yi grib ma la 'gom pa// mchod rten bshig dang 'dra bar gsungs// de dag bgyis gang so sor bshags// snying nas slob dpon sbyong pa ni// rmi lam du yang 'grub mi 'gyur// slob dpon yon tan bzung bya yi// skyon ni nam yang ma yin no// yon tan bzung na dngos grub ste// skyon brjod pa las dngos grub nyams// bdag gi sgo gsum bag med pas// nyes par bgyis kun mthol lo bshags// khyed kyi ba spu nyag re yi// bsod nams la yang dus gsum gyi// rgyal ba'i phrin las thams cad kyi// char yang bskrun par mi nus pas// nyid dang nyid kyis rjes bzung dang*// nyid la mchod dang phyag 'tshal sogs// bsod nams mi zad byed pa la// lhag par dang bas yid rang ngo// bskal pa bye bar mdo rgyud la// thos bsam sgom pas rab sbyangs kyang*// bla ma'i man ngag med pa yis// byin rlabs rim par mi rnyed gsungs// bla ma'i lung thob dngos grub mchog

/'bad med thob par 'gyur bas na// bdag sogs 'ching ba las grol phyir// zab mo'i 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// 'od (382)gsal lhan skyes bde ba che// thams cad stong pa bla ma yi// drin gyis gsal bar 'gyur bas na// bdag byin brlabs pa ma rnyed na// ngal ba 'bras med de bzhin du// bla mas phongs pa sngags dang ni// phyag rgya rnyed par mi 'gyur bas// mya ngan mi 'da' bdag gsol 'debs// mtho ris gnas su lha yi dbang*// sa steng 'khor los bsgyur ba nyid// sa 'og gdengs can bdag po'i tshul// oṃ yig gtsang ma rig byed mchog /'gro ba'i bla ma pha ma myes// grogs dang mgon dang byed po dang*// skyon 'joms yon tan kun gyi gnas// rdo rje'i rnal 'byor can la 'dud// kun 'gro'i ye shes brtan g.yo kun// 'gro 'ong med par khyab mdzad pa// skyes bu khyu mchog thub dbang po// dbul dang mgon med thams cad kyi// skyob pa yid bzhin nor bu la// mi bzad 'khor bas 'jigs pa bdag /'di phyi kun tu snying thag pas// sgo gsum dad pas khyod bsten no// rdo rje'i rigs la slob dpon bzung ba ni// dam tshig kun gyi rtsa bar yang yang gsungs// myos byed dman pa'i mchod dang sbyin sreg ni// mar dang bral na 'bral med rigs kyi chos// btang pas mi gnas don med de lta bur// slob dpon dang bral chos kyang don mi 'grub// de phyir dam tshig kun las khyad par du// slob dpon dam tshig 'bad nas bzung bar bgyi// dus dang gnas skabs dag ni thams cad du// dpal ldan bla ma'i phrin las bsgrub par shog /khyod nyid gang la mnyes pa de sgrub nas// mi mnyes byed pa thams cad spang bar shog /khyod nyid dgyes par gyur na bdag cag rnams// byang chub mchog thob las kyang lhag pa nyid// gal te khyod mi mnyes na tshe 'di la// byang chub thob kyang don mchog 'ga' ma (383)mchis// bdag gzhan dus gsum dge ba ma lus pa// gcig tu bsdus pa'i stobs las tshe 'di la// mchog gi dngos grub dam pa mngon 'gyur zhing*// rtag tu bla ma mnyes shing mchod byed shog

/bdag cag 'khor ba'i btson rar chud rnams la// 'dren pa khyod las skyabs gzhan ma mchis pas// mos gus rgyun chad med par gsol ba 'debs// thugs rjes g.yel ba med par gzigs su gsol// rdo rje slob dpon sku dang bdag gi lus// dbyer med rdo rje'i sku ru byin gyis rlobs// dpal ldan bla ma'i ci gsung sgrub pa dang*// gsung ngag dbyer med rdo rje'i gsung thob shog /thugs kyi gsang ba'i mdzod kun 'dzin pa dang*// thugs yid dbyer med 'dre bar byin gyis rlobs// bde stong zung 'jug stong nyid snying rje'i ngang*// thabs shes dbyer med bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug mchog /skye med 'od gsal mngon sum mthong zhing rtogs// rdo rje 'chang dngos khyod dang mtshungs par shog /bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ba dang*// zhi lhag dbyer med ting 'dzin rab 'byams can// sgo gsum spyod pa rnam dag dri med kyis// gzung 'dzin 'khor ba'i gnas las grol bar shog /bsam yas brjod bral rlabs chen thabs mchog dpag med pas// da lta nyid du mchog gi dngos grub sku bzhi'i bdag /nam mkha'i mthar thug 'gro rnams theg mchog la bkod nas// myur du phan bdes zhing kun khyab par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes slar yang yan lag bdun pa'i sgo nas 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba nan tu gdab cing*// gzhan yang*/ /yid la 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i rin po che// mgon po khyed la zhu zhing gsol ba ni// phan bde'i 'byung gnas thub bstan dam pa'i chos// thos bsam sgrub pas (384)rgyas par mdzad du gsol// thar pa'i ded dpon bstan 'dzin bshes gnyen rnams// sku la snyun med phrin las rab rgyas shing*// rtag tu sdug bsngal gyur pa'i 'gro ba rnams// thar pa'i bde la 'god par mdzad du gsol// dam chos sgrub la brtson pa thams cad kyis// zab lam bla ma'i mos gus mthar phyin nas// spang rtogs mthar son bla ma'i sa thob ste// gzhan phan tshad med 'grub par mdzad du gsol// de ma thob kyi gnas skabs thams cad du'ang*// bla ma mchog gis rtag tu rjes 'dzin cing*// lus dang longs spyod dge bas mnyes byas te// brtse bas byin rlabs 'jug par mdzad du gsol/

/dbang bzhi len pa ni/ /gsol ba btab pas 'khor rnams 'od du zhu// bla ma'i skur thim gnas gsum 'bru gsum gsal// bla ma ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dpral ba nas// 'od zer dkar po bdag gi dpral bar thim// bum pa'i dbang thob lus kyi sdig sgrib dag /sku yi byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs par gyur// bla ma ye shes mkha' 'gro'i mgrin pa nas// 'od zer dmar po bdag gi mgrin par thim// gsang ba'i dbang thob ngag gi sdig sgrib dag /gsung gi byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs par gyur// bla ma ye shes mkha' 'gro'i thugs ka nas// 'od zer sngon po bdag gi snying khar thim// sher ye'i dbang thob yid kyi sdig sgrib dag /thugs kyi byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs par gyur// slar yang gnas gsum 'od zer dkar dmar mthing*// gcig char 'phros nas bdag gi gnas gsum thim// bzhi pa'i dbang thob sgo gsum bag chags sbyangs// ye shes rdo rje'i byin rlabs zhugs par gyur// skye med phyag rgya ched du phyar mdzad nas// dgyes pas dgongs te ngo sprad stsal bar gyur// nam mkha' rig med stong pa la/ (385)rig bcas sems kyi rtsa ba bcun// rtsa ba gcun la lhug par zhog /ces gsungs mkha' dang rang sems dbyer med 'dres// nam mkha' bzhin tu rang sems skye 'jig dang*// mtha' dbus ngos bzung bral ba'i rang bab klod// bsam med ngang du cung zad klod de bzhag /ma bcos so ma rang shar lhan ne ba// lhun grub 'bad rtsol med pa'i ngang du btang*// dpal ldan bla ma'i sku dang bdag gi lus// dbyer med rdo rje'i sku ru byin gyis rlobs// dpal ldan bla ma'i ci gsung bsgrub pa dang*// gsung ngag dbyer med gsung gi rdo rjer shog /thugs kyi gsang ba'i mdzod kun 'dzin pa dang*// thugs yid dbyer med 'dres par byin gyis rlobs// bla ma dgyes pa'i bya ba kun bsgrubs nas// mdzad pa phrin las mtshungs par byin gyis rlobs// mgo bor bla ma'i cod pan 'chang*// lag tu rdo rje dril bu 'dzin// ngag tu gsang sngags rgyal po bzla// yid kyis zung 'jug bsgom par shog

/nongs pa bshags pa ni/ yig brgya brjod la/ bdag ni mi shes bag med dbang gyur bas// ma rig nyes pa'i tshogs rnams gang bgyis pa// brtse ldan khyod kyi spyan sngar bshags par bgyi// thugs rje'i rang bzhin can gyis bzod par gsol/ /bsdu rim ni/ /skyabs mchog khyed ni 'gro ba'i don rab mdzad// chos kyi sku la 'gyur ba mi mnga' yang*// gzugs sku bdag gi lus la rab bskyod nas// brtse ba chen pos byin gyis brlab tu gsol// bla ma ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro dgyes pa chen pos 'od zer gyi gong bur zhu ste rang la thim pas rang gi sgo gsum dang bla ma'i sku gsung thugs su dbyer med chu la chu bzhag pa ltar gyur/ /ces bzo med dang du yun ring mnyam (386) par bzhag la// shes shing spro na smon lam bka' rgya ma sogs theg pa chen po'i smon lam ji ltar rigs pa gdab bo// de nas bkra shis brjod pa ni/ /yon tan rab rdzogs gangs kyi ri bo bzhin// byin rlabs chu bos skal ldan tshims mdzad cing*// rang sems lhan cig skyes pa ston mdzad pa'i// chos rje bla ma mchog gi bkra shis shog /sgrub pa po la bu bzhin gzigs mdzad cing*// mi 'bral lus dang grib ma ji bzhin du// dam tshig can la dngos grub ster mdzad pa'i// yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi bkra shis shog /dam can sgrub pa po yi rjes 'brang zhing*// zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang mngon spyod sogs// sna tshogs phrin las tshul bzhin sgrub mdzad pa'i// chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /snang srid rang grol sgyu ma rmi lam bzhin// bde ba chen po rgyun chad med pa'i nyams// yid la byar med stong gsal nam mkha'i ngang*// bde chen phyag rgya chen po'i bkra shis shog /sgrub pa po la brten cing 'phrog pa dang*// skur ba 'debs pa'i skye 'gro gang yin pa// thams cad byang chub lam la 'god mdzad pa'i// mnyam med byang chub sems kyi bkra shis shog

/'khor ba mya ngan 'das pa thams cad kyi// bkra shis go 'phang ji snyed yod pa rnams// phun sum tshogs pa chu bo'i gzhung bzhin du// skye 'gro yongs la rtag tu bkra shis shog /bsod nams dar rgyas ri rgyal lhun po bzhin// snyan grags chen po nam mkha' bzhin tu khyab// tshe ring nad med gzhan don lhun gyis grub// yon tan rgya mtsho mchog gi bkra shis shog /rjes mchod pa'i ras ma ji ltar mchis pa dag kyang 'bags btsogs dang bag med spyod pa'i gnas su 'dor bar mi bya'o// ye shes mkha' 'gro gtsor gyur ba'i// shangs lugs bla ma mchod pa'i thabs// bris las (387) bsod nams gang thob pas// 'gro kun bla ma mchog 'grub shog /dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi// bsam kyis mi khyab rnam thar tshogs// de dag bdag gis myur 'grub nas// 'gro ba yongs kyi dpal gyur shog /'di la 'brel pa thogs tshad kyang*/ grub chen khyung po yab sras kyis// bde ba can du legs drangs nas// byang chub mchog tu lung ston shog /ces pa 'di'ang rje btsun chos kyi rgyal po thams cad mkhyen gzigs 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos rjes su gnang ba dang*/ rang nyid kyi mos pa chen po'i blos mtshams sbyar te// brgyud pa 'di nyid la mi phyed dad pa'i bag chags lhan skyes su mnga' ba karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sdes rje btsun rin po che'i gsung rabs byin rlabs kyi khyad par du gzhir bzhag /kha 'gengs 'os pa rnams gsar du sbyar te badz+ra tsit+ta ko ṭi'i sgrub gnas su rgyal ba lha las babs pa'i dus chen byang chub sgrub pa'i 'grub sbyor dang ldan pa'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes shin tu dge bar thun khongs gcig tu sug bris su bgyis pa 'gro mgon shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa rin po che sa chen yongs su khyab pa'i rgyur gyur cig /maṅga lam// (388)
